description: This file defines the ChartRenderer class responsible for rendering charts within the MigraDoc PDF generation library. It includes methods for formatting and rendering various chart components such as headers, footers, plot areas, and axes, utilizing external graphics and charting libraries.

classes.name: ChartRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a chart to an XGraphics object, handling layout, formatting, and drawing of chart components.

methods.name: GetFormattedTextArea
methods.description: Creates and formats a text area for chart labels or titles, with optional width.

methods.name: GetLeftRightVerticalPosition
methods.description: Calculates the top and bottom vertical positions for chart components.

methods.name: GetLeftRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the left side of the chart.

methods.name: GetRightRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the right side of the chart.

methods.name: GetHeaderRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the chart header.

methods.name: GetFooterRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the chart footer.

methods.name: GetTopRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the top of the chart.

methods.name: GetBottomRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the bottom of the chart.

methods.name: GetPlotRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for the plot area within the chart.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the chart components, preparing text areas and layout.

methods.name: AlignVertically
methods.description: Aligns a rectangle vertically based on specified vertical alignment.

methods.name: GetTopBottomWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width available for top and bottom areas.

methods.name: GetTopBottomHorizontalPosition
methods.description: Calculates the horizontal boundaries for top and bottom areas.

methods.name: RenderArea
methods.description: Renders a formatted text area within a specified rectangle.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the entire chart, including headers, footers, plot area, and axes.

methods.name: RenderPlotArea
methods.description: Renders the plot area of the chart within a specified rectangle.
